direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; scene at least 70% of main; side content condensed inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings, rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable in black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan may coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

fixes.change: Enlarge scene depth: add layered machine silhouettes and emerald material-flow trace from RECEIVING toward held jobs, static after one trace unless reduced motion is set.
Raise rail and side-zone secondary text to 16px body where space allows and keep micro-labels at 12px minimum.
Make verified findings glow emerald only on the three fact rows and sync hover/focus highlighting with Certificate, Receiving and substitute nodes in the scene.
Increase contrast of the dashed Certificate track endpoint so the 120 versus 80 gap reads instantly at 1366x768.
On selecting a path, open one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; keep Review recovery option disabled or clearly pending until a path is chosen.
Add a visible emerald selected state and focus ring to the chosen path card in both side zone and scene footer paths.
Add subtle depth and a single cinematic trace along t1 to t2 to t3 dependencies while preserving untracked-until-approval dashed treatment.
Enlarge the 1/2/3 proposal step chips to at least 36px targets with stronger focus ring.
Keep the strong silver cross-hatching and x marker, and add plain OFFLINE text inside CELL-MILL-2 preview so state does not rely on WILL GO OFFLINE wording alone.
Intensify state glow only around feasible recovery flow, leaving stopped cell visually quiet and silver.
Separate provider identity readiness checks from the investigation evidence task with distinct headings, status and controls in the side zone.
Replace the oversized diagonal cross lines on CELL-MILL-2 with consistent silver cross-hatching plus x marker and plain OFFLINE text, matching step 5.
Populate the empty Verified findings reserved zone with a compact pending state at 16px so the zone never reads as unfinished.
Apply the same cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE treatment to the constrained Split path and CELL-MILL-2 for one consistent stopped language.
Add emerald route traces only through the two remaining feasible paths, with no route through the offline cell.
Visually distinguish 3 blocked prior tasks from the 3 proposed replacements with silver blocked markers in the scene while keeping replacements untracked until approval.
Add a restrained cinematic glow to CELL-MILL-1 accepted-plan flow and keep CELL-MILL-2 silver, hatched and OFFLINE.
Condense the right evidence zone so Verify, Seal and Retain fit without crowding at 768px height; keep passphrase guidance to one line plus checklist.
Add state glow to the active Verify node and a completed emerald trace across 01-03 as each stage unlocks, respecting reduced motion.
Refit cascade to full viewport: shrink department cards and bottom controls so Assembly row and navigation are not clipped or overlapped by OFFLINE captions.
Remove repeated OFFLINE labels stamped over every machine; use one department status line plus silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text per stopped machine.
Strengthen living emerald flow along the CNC mills to CNC lathes recovery route with depth and glow, and make legend swatches match machine states exactly.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual or add a cropped cascade inset so machine states and emerald flow remain legible at reading width within the required order.
Raise small table and caption text toward 16px and increase contrast on partner-role rows for faster judge scanning.
Add one bold outcome metric strip near the hero visual reinforcing 70 parts, 35h accepted plan and 48h saved.
